data.one_liner: A customizable grid view widget with items that automatically adjust height based on content.
data.what_it_does: Provides a grid view widget for Flutter that automatically computes the height of each grid item according to its content, removing the need for strict aspect ratios. It supports properties like crossAxisCount, spacing, physics, padding, and shrinkWrap.
use_when: You need a grid layout where items have varying content heights.
You want to avoid fixed aspect ratios for grid cells.
avoid_when: You need complex staggered grid layouts supported by other dedicated packages.
You require advanced layout builders not covered by basic grid properties.
strengths: Automatically adjusts item heights based on content
Easy to use with standard grid properties like crossAxisCount and spacing
weaknesses: Limited properties compared to more advanced grid libraries

alternatives.name: flutter_staggered_grid_view
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you need advanced staggered grid layouts with varying item sizes and patterns.
